description: Draft method for R&D program budget, restriction, actual/forecast, and milestone cash evidence packets.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library (draft)
provenance.source: Independently authored from audited source entrypoint; see references/source-provenance.md
provenance.license: MIT source notice recorded; no source text/code copied

routing.when_to_use: Use for active R&D program period budgets, actual/forecast reconciliation, restricted funding, F&A basis evidence, and milestone cash timing.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for grant discovery; use research-grant-opportunities.
Do not use for accounting operation or classification decisions; Sara/controller owns them.
Do not use for broad market sizing, valuation, or program go/kill decisions.

expected_outputs.name: evidence_packet
expected_outputs.description: Source-linked period table, actual/forecast distinctions, cash scenarios, exceptions, and owner questions.

forbidden_actions: Apply accounting or award rules without current owner-approved authority.
Write accounting, bank, award, or program records.
Represent scenario outputs as actuals or approval.
verification_steps: Check period, currency, value type, source, and as-of date for each figure.
Trace restrictions and F&A basis to current award-specific sources or mark unresolved.
Recompute visible arithmetic and keep scenario assumptions explicit.
Confirm owner questions remain with Sara/controller and no external mutation is claimed.
completion_criteria: Draft packet separates actual, committed, budget, forecast, and proposed values.
Material source gaps and accounting-owner questions are visible.
No business, accounting, or external action is represented as completed.
known_limitations: No legal/accounting/current policy verification is built into this method.
No evaluation, certification, release, or source-script admission is claimed.
